prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Baytown, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1104; do not mention it.)
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Baytown, Texas, and had the green light, or so I believed, when another vehicle came through the intersection from the opposite direction and struck the front driver's side of my car. The impact was hard enough to jolt my vehicle sideways and set off the airbags. I stopped as soon as I could, checked on myself, and called for help. My neck was stiff and sore right away, and the pain has continued since then, so I have been seeing a doctor for a neck strain. I did not lose consciousness and was able to exchange information with the other driver at the scene. I am providing this account to support my claim for damage to my vehicle and for the medical care I have needed as a result of this collision.
